criteria.requirement: Extend UnicodeDecoder with opt-in recursive=False/max_depth=32. Recursive mode builds new built-in dict/list/tuple containers, decodes bytes values using configured encoding/errors, leaves keys and opaque objects untouched. Preserve container types, reject active-path cycles with path diagnostics (shared DAG is legal), enforce finite depth. Default shallow in-place behavior stays unchanged. No arbitrary object getter/deepcopy or claim to preserve alias identity of copied shared subtrees.
